description: A valid RS256 JWS over "Payload" whose 2048-bit key has the odd public exponent e = 2^33 + 1 < n (key generated with OpenSSL 4.1.0 genpkey rsa_keygen_pubexp:8589934593, signed and checked with node:crypto, Node v24.21.0, OpenSSL 3.5.8): RFC 8017 §3.1 allows any odd e < n, but polyjose bounds e at 2^33 − 1 through the rsa crate (RsaPublicKey::new_with_size_limits) against RSA verification DoS, so the key is weak (ADR 0026 §2 step 8)
